products.name: Recyclable PVC-free Banners
products.shortDescription: PVC-free polyester banner fabric printed with water-based latex inks, hemmed and eyeleted to size, for trade shows, retail promotions, factory signage and outdoor events where the client needs the banner to be recyclable at end of life and does not want to send PVC flex to landfill after a two-week campaign.
products.fullDescription: Conventional banners are printed on PVC flex, which cannot be recycled and releases chlorine compounds when burnt. Our PVC-free banners use a polyester fabric that takes the same water-based latex inks and finishes, so they look the same on the day but can go into a textile or polyester recycling stream afterwards. They are available in any size up to 5 m wide in a single piece, with hemmed edges, eyelets every 500 mm or pole pockets, and can be printed single- or double-sided. Typical uses are trade-show backdrops, retail window promotions, factory and warehouse safety signage, construction-site hoardings, event stage backdrops and temporary wayfinding. We can also take back used banners from repeat customers and route them to a recycler, so the material does not end up in landfill. Lead time is typically three to five working days from artwork approval, and we can turn around urgent orders in 48 hours for sizes up to 3 m. Artwork should be supplied as a PDF with fonts outlined and images at 100 dpi at full size, with a 50 mm bleed on every side for hemming. We can also provide a design service if you only have a logo and some copy. Colour matching to Pantone references is available on request, and we will send a printed proof strip for approval before running the full job on orders over 20 square metres.
